inhibition of host TRAFs by virus

definition: A process in which a symbiont interferes with, inhibits or disrupts a TRAF-mediated signal transduction pathway in the host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated suppression of host TRAF-mediated signal transduction
